summary.text: Wendy Larson is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 19, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an at-large member of the Kensington School District school board, a post she assumed in 2025, and a retired marketing and media professional.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Larson was born in Mineola, New York, and earned a high school diploma from Portsmouth High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 1979.
Her career experience includes working as a marketing consultant and as a sales manager and executive.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Kensington for 43 years, serves as secretary of the Historical Society of Kensington, and volunteers with the Exeter-area Special Olympics pickleball program.
Larson's current term on the Kensington school board ends in 2028.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records her as having lost the 2024 general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 19.
In her 2026 survey answers, she said her main campaign messages are holding the state accountable for paying a larger share of public education costs and reducing property taxes.
